question: Which event did Gurpreet Singh win the team gold in at the 16th Asian Shooting Championships?
solution:
The correct answer is __**25 meters centre fire.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• **Gurpreet Singh won the team gold in the 25 meters centre fire event at the Asian Shooting Championships in Kazakhstan.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• **Gurpreet Singh, along with Rajkanwar Singh Sandhu and Ankur Goel, won the team gold in the 25 meters centre fire event.**
 
• **The Indian team secured a total of 1733 points to win the gold medal.**
 
• **Gurpreet Singh had already won the 25-meter standard pistol individual gold a day earlier.**
 
• **India’s strong performance in shooting at the Asian Championships highlighted their dominance in the event.**
